QuestInfo.name: [The Story of Pebble and Wind] Sketching the Traces of Nature
QuestInfo.0: Find a Trace of Nature and make a drawing of it.
QuestInfo.1: Find the Trace of Nature drawn on a leaf somewhere in Maple World, and return with a sketch of it.
QuestInfo.2: Ahhh... Spending time in nature really helps give you peace of mind, don't it?

default.0: Oh dear... Is that Trace of Nature drawn on the leaf still proving tough to find?\r\nCome visit me again once you've found it and made a sketch, okay?
